title: Resistor networks and circuit solving
concepts_taught: Derive series resistance from a common current and loop potential changes.
Derive parallel resistance from a common p.d. and junction currents.
Choose independent junction and loop equations for a circuit.
Interpret a negative solved current as flow opposite to an assumed direction.
skills_students_can_now_use: Derive the combined resistance formulas for series and parallel resistors using Kirchhoff’s laws.
Use the series and parallel formulas in resistor networks.
Use junction and loop equations together to solve simple circuits.
Check current directions, signs and energy consistency in a completed solution.
